outlet: The Spokesman-Review, 2020-10-02, 'Municipal Judge Tracy Staab faces attorney Marshall Casey for vacancy on appeals court'
notes: Staab: Spokane Municipal Court judge since 2009, earlier an appellate attorney for the Federal Defenders of Eastern Washington (from 2005) and in the city public defender's office (2003); admitted to the bar in 1993; cites high bar-association ratings; running to replace retiring Judge Kevin Korsmo.
